description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git format-patch' functionality. It contains a series of test cases with expected outputs to validate various features and options of the format-patch command, including email headers, threading, signature handling, filename options, and cover letter behavior.

methods.name: check_patch
methods.description: Verifies the patch email format by checking for 'From:', 'Date:', and 'Subject:' headers.

methods.name: check_author
methods.description: Validates that the 'From:' header in the patch email correctly quotes or encodes the author’s name, handling special characters and encoding as needed.

methods.name: append_signoff
methods.description: Appends a Signed-off-by line to the commit message and outputs the result with line numbers.
